appearance.pointingHand.description: Shows a pointing hand over buttons, as web pages do.

appearance.style.description: The theme Orden is drawn in.

appearance.uiFont.description: The face of menus, lists and settings; any font installed here, by its name.

editor.attachments.description: Where a picture or file you paste or drop into a note is saved.

editor.canvasRotation.description: Turning two fingers on a touchpad or screen rotates the canvas.

editor.canvasRotationSnaps.description: A rotation that ends near a right angle settles on it.

editor.closeBrackets.description: Typing an opening bracket or quote adds the closing one too.

editor.codeHighlighting.description: The colours code in a note is highlighted in.

editor.codeLineNumbers.description: Numbers the lines of code blocks.

editor.focusMode.description: Dims everything but the paragraph you are writing in.

editor.ligatures.description: Joins pairs such as -> or != into one sign, in code only or everywhere.

editor.lineSpacing.description: The space between the lines of a note.

editor.lineWidth.description: How wide a line of a note grows before it wraps.

editor.newLinks.description: Wikilinks name the note, so a link survives it being renamed; both spellings are read either way.

editor.newPages.description: The paper size a new page note starts with.

editor.noteName.description: How the name of a new unique note is made from the date and time.

editor.textSize.description: How large the text of notes is.

editor.typewriterMode.description: Keeps the line you are writing in the middle of the screen.

export.appearance.description: Whether an export is light, dark, or as the app is now.

export.footer.description: Text at the bottom of every page; ${title}, ${date} and ${year} are filled in.

export.header.description: Text at the top of every page; ${title}, ${date} and ${year} are filled in.

export.margin.description: The space around the edge of each page, such as 20mm or 1in.

export.orientation.description: Whether pages are upright or on their side.

export.paper.description: The paper size of a PDF or a print.

general.addTaskFromAnyApp.description: The Add task shortcut works even while another app is in front.

general.ctrlTabByUse.description: Ctrl+Tab goes to the tab used last, as in VS Code; off goes through the tabs in the order they sit.

general.developerMode.description: Shows terminals and the other tools for writing code.

general.dns.description: How web pages look up the addresses of sites. Over HTTPS, nobody between you and the provider can read or change the lookups.

general.dnsProvider.description: The address of a DNS over HTTPS server, starting with https://

general.hardwareAcceleration.description: Draws the app on the graphics card; turn it off if the window flickers or stays blank.

general.hiddenTabs.description: What the web pages of another space do while it is out of sight: keep running, pause, or ask the first time.

general.keepVersionEvery.description: How often a note you are editing is saved as a version you can go back to in History.

general.keepVersionsFor.description: How long those versions are kept before they are deleted.

general.language.description: The language Orden’s menus and settings are in.

general.memorySaver.description: Unloads web pages that have been out of sight for a while to free memory; they load again when you return.

general.remindBefore.description: How long before a task’s time it reminds you, unless the task says otherwise.

general.restoreTerminalHistory.description: Brings back what each terminal showed after Orden restarts; off forgets it on quit.

general.searchEngine.description: Where words typed into a web tab’s address bar are searched.

general.searchEngineAddress.description: The search address, with %s where the words go.

general.shell.description: The shell a new terminal starts.

general.silentMode.description: Hides the tips Orden shows while you get to know it.

general.smartDates.description: Reads dates, times and fields out of what you type into Add task, such as “tomorrow 9am”.

general.stayInTray.description: Keeps Orden running in the tray after its window closes, so reminders still ring.

general.swipeBetweenPages.description: Two fingers sideways on the touchpad go back and forward.

general.terminalTextSize.description: How large the text in terminals is.

general.undatedInToday.description: Today also lists the tasks that have no start date; off shows only those dated today or earlier.

general.warnBeforeQuitting.description: Asks before Orden quits with terminals open: always, or only while something runs in one.
